name: Northstar Manufacturing Company, Inc.
old_description: Northstar Manufacturing Company was founded in 1980 and has since become the leading designer and manufacturer of innovative products for under-vehicle servicing of automobiles and trucks. Northstar takes great pride in its leadership position in the industry and is constantly at work designing and developing new problem-solving products for the automotive aftermarket. After the initial development of each new product, thorough testing is done to insure each and every product meets the strictest guidelines.
about:
Northstar Manufacturing Company, Inc. was founded in 1980 in Minnetonka, Minnesota. The company began in response to a growing industry need for specialized under-vehicle service products for automobiles and trucks. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed in the available information.

The company designs and manufactures a complete line of wheel alignment products and tools for the automotive aftermarket. Its operations span product development, manufacturing, and thorough testing to ensure each item meets strict performance and installation guidelines. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not specified in the source material.

Northstar serves the automotive aftermarket, supplying repair shops, dealerships, and service centers that perform under-vehicle maintenance on passenger cars and light trucks. Its product line addresses alignment adjustment needs, though specific customer names are not provided.

The business was started to fill a gap in the market for problem-solving adjustment products. The company emphasizes that all products undergo rigorous testing to meet the strictest guidelines for performance and ease of installation, a practice it cites as central to its approach.
